task.title: P6-189: Give the delete confirm two destination pickers and honest counts
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-189. Size: M. Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**Give the delete confirm the two destination pickers and honest counts** (absorbs `P6-111`). Step 4 of specs/collection-deletion.md. The dialog gains a picker for the haves (defaulting to the parent) and a separate one for the wants (defaulting to **"Remove from Collection"** — the agreed label for the `Discard` variant on *both* sides, resolved 2026-08-05), because a have is a physical object that must be somewhere and a want is an intention that was probably scoped to the deck being deleted. Three corrections to the copy, all of which are `P6-111`: the card count becomes **`present` for this collection only**, not `present + present_rollup` — since children now survive, rolling their cards in would overstate what is being relocated; the **wants count is stated**, where today it is never mentioned at all; and the child-collections line ("2 collections move up to Shoebox") must render from the same snapshot the write acts on, so a stale or failed tree read cannot silently omit it the way `tree_manage.rs:742`'s `descendants > 0` guard does today. **"This cannot be undone" must go** — it stops being true. Keep the property verified in `phase-6-probes/P6-017d-confirm-copy.md`: the dialog reads its own `DeleteReq` snapshot and names the collection it will actually delete. **Prereq: `P6-188`.**
